description: Source code for evaluation helper functions related to Kubernetes RBAC policies, including matching rules for verbs, API groups, resources, resource names, and non-resource URLs.

methods.name: VerbMatches
methods.description: Checks if a given verb matches any of the verbs in a policy rule, considering 'all' verb.

methods.name: APIGroupMatches
methods.description: Checks if a requested API group matches any of the API groups in a policy rule, considering 'all' group.

methods.name: ResourceMatches
methods.description: Determines if a resource and subresource match a policy rule's resources, including wildcards.

methods.name: ResourceNameMatches
methods.description: Checks if a requested resource name matches any resource name in the policy rule.

methods.name: NonResourceURLMatches
methods.description: Checks if a URL matches any non-resource URL in the policy rule, including wildcards.

methods.name: CompactString
methods.description: Creates a compact string representation of a PolicyRule for escalation messages.
